name: Go
description: Installs the Go toolchain on a selectable channel or release line.

version.description: Channel (latest), a minor line (1.27), or an exact version (major.minor.patch).

stateDir.description: If set, puts this feature's data at this path, which must be inside the remote user's home. Mount a volume there to persist it across rebuilds.

toolchain.description: Sets GOTOOLCHAIN: local runs only the installed Go, path also uses newer ones on the PATH, auto downloads what go.mod asks for.
